_comment: Prefab industry templates for the FE Copilot Quick Research flow. Loaded inline by frontend/assets/js/app.js (INDUSTRY_TEMPLATES). i18n keys for the tile UI live in frontend/assets/js/i18n.js (tpl.<id>.name and tpl.<id>.tagline). Form-field copy is intentionally English so the agent receives a stable signal regardless of the FE's chosen UI locale.

fields.tech_stack: Splunk for SIEM + observability, Datadog APM, Oracle + DB2 mainframe, Java/Kotlin microservices, Kafka, AWS + on-prem
fields.notes: Regulatory pressure from DORA, PCI DSS, SOX, FCA SYSC. Splunk renewal in 2027 ~$5M annual. Looking to consolidate SIEM + observability + search into one platform. Compliance audit in Q3.
